Output.Description: Edit all settings for your output configuration in this dialog.

Source.Title: Source value
Source.Description: Configure the value for this output configuration.
Source.Label: Source

SourceType.Title: Step 1 - Select source type
SourceType.Description: Select where the value comes from.

DeviceType.Title: Step 1 - Display type
DeviceType.Description: Select the type of device you want to configure.

Device.Title: Output device
Device.Description: Configure the settings for this output device configuration.

TestPanel.Title: Step - Test output device
TestPanel.Description: Test the functionality of this output device configuration.

Stepper.Title: Step 2 - Stepper settings
Stepper.Description: Select the stepper and configure how values map to its movement.
Stepper.Label: Stepper

Calibrate.Title: Step 3 - Calibrate stepper
Calibrate.Description: Use the jog buttons to adjust the stepper position and set home position.
Calibrate.Hint: Use the arrow keys to select the step size. Use space to move the stepper. Use enter to set the home position.

Servo.Title: Step 2 - Servo settings
Servo.Description: Select the servo and map the value range to its rotation.
Servo.Label: Servo

Output.Title: Step 2 - Output settings
Output.Description: Select one or more pins and configure the brightness.
Output.Label: Output
Output.DynamicBrightnessDescription: Dynamic brightness is controlled by current value ($)
Output.StaticBrightnessDescription: Set the static brightness for all values other than 0.

ShiftRegister.Title: Step 2 - Output shift register settings
ShiftRegister.Description: Select the shift register and one or more of its outputs.
ShiftRegister.Label: Output Shift Register

SevenSegment.Title: Step 2 - 7-Segment settings
SevenSegment.Description: Select the module and configure which digits show the value.
SevenSegment.Label: 7-Segment

AdvancedOptions.Title: Advanced options
AdvancedOptions.Description: Configure advanced display options for the 7-segment module.

LcdDisplay.Title: Step 2 - LCD Display settings
LcdDisplay.Description: Select the LCD display and configure its settings.
LcdDisplay.Label: LCD Display

CustomDevice.Title: Step 2 - Custom Device settings
CustomDevice.Description: Select the device and the message that receives the value.
CustomDevice.Label: Custom Device
